exactRemainingFieldGap.meaning: Existing analysis-result-1 persists only version, analytical manifest and native JSON result. Neither its producer nor reader records an original XLSX attachment, recorded export-byte hash, parent-result export record, export contract/sheet domain or authorization to publish a retained workbook. A JSON result hash cannot be substituted for an original workbook byte hash.

actualReadOnlyArchiveInspection.databaseAccess: Existing workspace DEV database; inspection used BEGIN READ ONLY with transaction_read_only=on. Actual loadAnalysisResult readback separately used PGOPTIONS=-c default_transaction_read_only=on.

otherExistingWorkbookEvidence.notAnEligibleSubstitute: These existing offline conditional-company replay engineering workbooks use a different bundle/manifest/result contract. Their offline binary/cell identities do not bind any of the nine retained analysis-result-1 producers or authorize public delivery of a private/local artifact. No files or bundles were exposed, imported into the public catalog or used as fallback.
